title.narrative: Salvador Social Multi-Sector Service Delivery Program III

description.narrative: The objective of this Program is to increase access to quality health, education, and social assistance services for human development in the Municipality of Salvador, in the State of Bahia in Brazil. Building on the first and second phases of Salvador Social, the Program will improve key results in social sectors through strengthened governance and management, digital technologies, and intersectoral action.In health, the Program will increase supply and strengthen monitoring, evaluation, and information systems, telehealth capacities, and referral networks, focusing on improving access to specialized care. In social assistance, it will expand access to the Unified Social Assistance System and targeted benefits packages, including through strengthened systems and delivery mechanisms. In education, the Program will support learning results in basic education, including through the better education quality monitoring systems, full-time schooling, and a focus on vulnerable students. Intersectoral interventions will focus on mental health and psychosocial wellbeing through improved access to and quality of inclusive education and community-based mental health services.
To increase access to quality health, education, and social assistance services for human development in the Municipality of Salvador.
